{{Quote|We've had skirmishes at Csaus, Sarvchi, Shihon, and now Jamiron. It seems to me the Ascendancy is doing its very best to tear itself apart. Willingly, even eagerly.|[[Patriarch]] [[Stybla'mi'ovodo]]|<ref name="Lesser Evil" />|translated=!}}
Around [[18 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> during a [[Grysk plot to engineer a Chiss civil war|crisis]] in the [[Chiss Ascendancy]], a '''skirmish''' was fought at the astronomical object [[Csaus]].<ref name="Lesser Evil" />

==Behind the scenes==
The skirmish at Csaus was mentioned in the [[2021]] novel ''[[Thrawn Ascendancy: Lesser Evil]]'', the final volume of [[Timothy Zahn]]'s [[Star Wars: The Ascendancy Trilogy|''Ascendancy Trilogy'']].<ref name="Lesser Evil" />
